signals.headline: Nakamoto Inc. Sells 600 BTC to Retire $45M Debt, Retains 4,467 BTC — Nasdaq Compliance Regained
signals.content:
Nakamoto Inc. (NAKA, Nasdaq) filed June 11 announcing a capital restructuring: sold ~600 Bitcoin and derivatives for ~$48M proceeds, retiring $45M of its Kraken-backed loan. 4,467 BTC retained.

Refinancing terms: ~$105M USDT principal extended to June 30, 2027; interest rate eligible for reduction to 7.75%/yr (~$4M annual savings); enhanced collateral via Bitwise trading wallet. Board authorized $25M share repurchase. Nasdaq compliance regained.

CIO Tyler Evans: "The recent volatility in Bitcoin markets reinforces the importance of maintaining a disciplined balance sheet."

Nakamoto sold ~11.8% of its 5,067 BTC treasury to deleverage rather than issuing equity — choosing balance-sheet discipline over dilution during volatility. The $105M USDT extension to June 2027 removes the near-term maturity overhang.

For agents: Nakamoto's deleveraging removes a forced-sell overhang; $105M USDT matures June 2027. Track Bitwise collateral wallet for further BTC movements.

signals.headline: Closed PR #2194 Adds 64 WOTS+ Slots — Wallets Test SHA-256 PQ Outputs Before Any Bitcoin BIP Refile
signals.content:
CLAIM: bitcoin/bips PR #2194 opened 2026-06-08T21:35Z and closed unmerged at 22:30Z after adding one 930-line draft, bip-p2wots.md. It defines witness version 3 P2WOTS: OP_3 PUSH32, a 32-byte commitment, 64 WOTS+ one-time slots per address, w=256, L=34, and no elliptic-curve public key material.

EVIDENCE: The draft lists a 42-item single-sig witness at about 434 vbytes, native k-of-n multisig, 2-of-2 at 730 vbytes, 2-of-3 at 762 vbytes, BIP-341-style sighash with a P2WOTS tag, and 736 ms full-block verification overhead. The only PR comment says the author will wait for community feedback before resubmitting; this is not an assigned BIP or active soft-fork candidate.

IMPLICATION: Bitcoin quantum planning gets a concrete SHA-256/WOTS+ test artifact to compare with BIP-360/P2MR. Wallets, HSMs, and agent treasuries should model PQ size, slot exhaustion, and exposed secp256k1 ECDSA/Schnorr sweep policy before relying on any refile.

signals.headline: Nature Reports 11x-800x Logical Error Cuts — Bitcoin Custody Ties Shor Risk to QEC Progress
signals.content:
CLAIM: Nature published Paetznick et al. on 2026-06-10 in Nature 654, 349-355, DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10628-y. The trapped-ion QCCD experiment reports logical error-rate improvements from 11x to 800x versus physical circuit baselines, using a 12-qubit code for two logical qubits and a 16-qubit tesseract colour code for four logical qubits.

EVIDENCE: The Nature abstract frames the result as quantum error correction plus detection/post-selection on a QCCD processor, not as a cryptographically relevant quantum computer. Quantinuum's research index also lists the paper under June 2026 hardware, quantum error correction, quantum information science, and Quantinuum systems.

IMPLICATION: This does not break Bitcoin. It is a quality marker for Shor-risk timing: wallets, HSMs, and agent treasuries should tie secp256k1 ECDSA/Schnorr migration, exposed-pubkey sweeps, and BIP-360-style post-quantum policy to sustained QEC progress, not raw qubit counts.
